The eccentric inventor {npc:Rapanaio}, hidden in the depths of Kazordoon, swears there is an island full of evil waiting to devour travellers. Help him finish his submarine (mechanical fish, rum, juice, a machine from Scutty and a nautical map), travel with him to the {wiki:Isle of Evil} and kill the six bosses of the castle. You get access to the island, 6666 experience, the {item:Fan Doll of King Tibianus}, the {item:Mechanical Fishing Rod} and two achievements.
Old texts and fairy tales speak of a secret island of evil...
Level 35 (Gate of Expertise door to Rapanaio's boat); level 50 recommended.
Access to {wiki:Yalahar} (to fish in the sewers).
or equivalent, to open the entrance to The Cave
between 3 and 30, as bait (or buy a Mechanical Fish on the Market)
500 gp in reserve (Scutty's fine if you hit a drilling worm)
A unique item from each boss of the castle (using the corpse)
In mission 6 (**The Secret**) {npc:Rapanaio}'s submarine takes you to the island; when you complete the quest you get access.
Rapanaio's submarine, in Kazordoon, is the only way to get there (it passes through a level 35 Gate of Expertise).
From mission 5 (**The Map to Evil**): you dig the entrance with a {item:Shovel} between the two mossy stones.
Premium only: a {item:Magic Forcefield} blocks the entrance for ex-premium players.
All missions start with {npc:Rapanaio}: {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes} to hand in what he asked for.
Bring plenty of {item:Nail|Nails}: they are lost when fishing fails.
In Liberty Bay buy 11 vials from {npc:Red Lilly}: 10 for the rum and one extra for the mission 3 juice.
On the island, use the corpses of **all** the bosses **before** using the one of the {creature:Evil Mastermind}.

In **Kazordoon**, go down to the {wiki:Steamship} and go up **one floor**: that is where {npc:Rapanaio} is. The easiest way is to arrive by Steamship: in {wiki:Cormaya} (with {npc:Gurbasch}) or in **Farmine** (with {npc:Thorgrin}) say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}; you arrive at the underground port, next to {npc:Brodrosch}, and only have to go up one floor. You can also walk in through the mountain entrance (see {wiki:Route: Kazordoon|the Kazordoon route}; bring a {item:Rope} and {item:Shovel}).
Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:fight}, {key:evil}, {key:isle of evil} and {key:yes}. He accepts you as his hero.

After you tell him about the {key:isle of evil}, Rapanaio gives you access to the room to the **west**. There is a {item:Box (Quest)|box} there with the book {item:Isle of Evil (Book)}. It is optional.

Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Rapanaio}. You receive the {item:Mechanical Fishing Rod}. He wants a {item:Mechanical Fish} from the Yalahar sewers, which can only be caught using {item:Nail|Nails} as bait.
You can also hand in a {item:Mechanical Fish} bought on the {wiki:The Market (Object)|Market}.

Travel to **Yalahar**: in **Liberty Bay** talk to {npc:Captain Max} ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}); you need the **Novice** rank of the Explorer Society for him to talk to you. If you paid the password to {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice}, you can also go from Thais with {npc:Captain Bluebear}. You arrive at the port, **south** of the city centre. To enter the sewers use a {item:Sewer Grate|sewer grate} (for example, the one right **east of the depot**): you go down 1 floor.
Go to the **Yalahar** sewers with the rod and the nails and fish as usual (use the rod on the water). Repeat until you catch the {item:Mechanical Fish}.
When fishing fails you can lose the nail, take 35 energy damage and be turned into a {creature:Skeleton} for a few seconds. Do not fish with low health.

Go up the same way you came down. To return to Kazordoon, go to the Yalahar port and talk to {npc:Captain Cookie}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} (400 gp) or {key:thais} (800 gp), and {key:yes}. Since the next mission is in Liberty Bay, take the chance to go there now.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Rapanaio}. He wants **10 {item:Vial|vials} of {item:Rum}** — it has to be in vials.
Go to the **Liberty Bay** tavern, where the nearest {item:Rum Cask} is. Buy vials from {npc:Red Lilly}, nearby, and use them on the barrel until you have 10 vials of rum.
Rum Cask in the Liberty Bay tavern
Buy one extra vial: you will need it for the juice in the next mission.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Rapanaio}: he wants a {item:Vial|vial} of {item:Fruit Juice}. With an empty vial in your backpack, use a {item:Juice Squeezer} on any fruit.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Rapanaio}. He needs a steam machine from his friend Scutty.
Go to {npc:Scutty}, in **Kazordoon**, and say {key:hi}, {key:machine}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. He lends you the {item:Worm Punisher}.
Go through the door to the **south**. Use the {item:Worm Punisher} on the {item:Crucible} when it is **red**: it becomes a {item:Heated Worm Punisher} for **10 seconds**.

The worms pop up from the holes like in *whack-a-mole*. With the hammer still hot, use it on the {item:Wormhole (Carrion Worm)|Carrion Worms} when they appear. Repeat (heating the hammer again) until you hit **6** Carrion Worms. You earn the achievement **Worm Whacker**.
**Do not hit** the drilling worms (they appear as {item:Wormhole (Rotworm)|Rotworm}). If you do, you pay 500 gp to Scutty and start the task over from scratch.
Go back to {npc:Scutty} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. You receive the {item:Machine Crate}.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Rapanaio}. He needs a nautical map from the Explorer Society, kept at an outpost north-east of Carlin.
Go to **Northport**, the village **north-east of Carlin** (and west of Ab'Dendriel), and ask {npc:Mortimer} for the {key:nautical map}.
Open the entrance to The Cave
Go to the beach to the **east** and dig with the {item:Shovel} between the two rocks to reveal the entrance to {wiki:The Cave}.
The spot between the two rocks where you have to dig
Enter and go down one more floor. Go to the **north-east** room and go down the stairs. Then head **north** until you find a {item:Box (Brown Quest)|box} with the {item:Nautical Map}. Open it.

In The Cave there are {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}, {creature:Bandit|Bandits} and pirates ({creature:Pirate Marauder|Marauders}, {creature:Pirate Cutthroat|Cutthroats} and {creature:Pirate Buccaneer|Buccaneers}).

Go back the same way: go up the stairs of the north-east room and then use the {item:Rope} where you went down, up to the beach east of Northport. Then return to Kazordoon (by boat to a city with a Steamship or on foot).
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Rapanaio}. He tells you to meet him at the boat, down below.
Pass through the level 35 {item:Gate of Expertise} to the **south** and go down the stairs. Rapanaio is waiting for you next to the submarine boat.
Stairs to the boat (behind the Gate of Expertise)
Set off for the Isle of Evil
Prepare potions and runes for a big fight. Then say {key:hi}, {key:mission} to Rapanaio and answer {key:yes} to all the questions (there are 8 confirmations) until he says *"So be it!"*.
Rapanaio's submarine is the **only** way to reach the {wiki:Isle of Evil} (east of Mistrock). On the island, fight your way to the stairs and go up. Approach the castle carefully.

**Do not pull the lever** near the castle: you fall one floor and land in the middle of {creature:Infernal Frog|Infernal Frogs}. If you fall, the wiki does not describe how to get out of there: be ready to fight your way through the frogs.
Inside the castle there is one boss per floor. Kill them in this order and **use the corpse** of each one to receive a unique item.
If you use the corpse of the {creature:Evil Mastermind} you can no longer use the corpses of the other bosses. Use them first. Take it easy and do not let yourself get cornered.
After the six bosses, use the corpse of the {creature:Evil Mastermind} to obtain the {item:Fan Club Membership Card}.

Go back to {npc:Rapanaio}, next to the boat: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. He tells you to show the card to King Tibianus. To return say {key:back} and {key:yes}. He takes you back to **Kazordoon**, next to the Steamship. From there, to get to Thais, take the Steamship or walk.
Show the card to the king

Go to **Thais** castle and talk to {npc:King Tibianus}: {key:hail king} and {key:fan club membership card}. You receive 6666 experience, the {item:Fan Doll of King Tibianus} and the achievement **King Tibianus Fan**.
Completing the quest gives you access to the {wiki:Isle of Evil}.
